findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jerry_get_account · Private data: jerry_request_quotes, jerry_request_final_price · Public sink: jerry_get_account, jerry_start_shopping, jerry_update_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jerry_get_account · Private data: jerry_request_quotes, jerry_request_final_price · Public sink: jerry_get_account, jerry_start_shopping, jerry_update_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
